studies.title: Radio across the ocean
studies.caption: Guglielmo Marconi's station in Cornwall sends the letter S in Morse across the Atlantic to Newfoundland, with no wire.
studies.prompt: Interior close scene at Newfoundland1901, a wireless experimenter listening through an early telephone earpiece beside simple receiver apparatus and wire connections on a rough table, cable rising toward window. Plain early electrical equipment, no broadcast microphone, transistor radio or modern display.
